manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 239
text:
Page 001
001-1. junitius junitius TS PR
001-2. Nyanism junitius CL/RD TL Paragon Scans
001-3. discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx

Page 002
002-1. A CATER- PILLAR?
002-2. AREN'T you GoiNG TO WASH IT?
002-3. YOU STILL WANT TO WEAR IT? I CAN BUY YOU A NEW PAIR.
002-4. AREN'T YOU THE ONE WHO WANTS ME TO WEAR IT!? DONT TRY TO PUSH THE BLAME ON.ME!

Page 003
003-1. SHE'SSO MUCH SMARTER NOW.
003-2. WE'LL GET NEWONES ANYWAY!
003-3. THE HUMAN BODY TENDS TO SECRETE MORE DOPAMINE AT NIGHT, WHICH MAKES YOUR MIND MORE HYPERACTIVE AND CAUSES YOU TO DO THINGS THAT YOU NORMALLYWOULDN'T.
003-4. THE WARRIORESS HAS BEEN LEARNING ABOUT MODERNCULTUREALLALONG, ANDEVENMANAGEDTOUSE SOME OF THAT INCREDIBLE KNOWLEDGEYESTERDAY,
003-5. IT'S NORMAL FOR COUPLES TO DO THAT IN MODERNTIMES.
003-6. AND I NEARLY THOUGHT THAT I WAS A PERVERT WHEN I WOKE UP..

Page 004
004-1. I AM ACTUALLY BEING LED ASTRAY BY THE LITTLE OLD LADY, AND I HAVE BEEN UNCONSCIOUSLYSEEING THINGS FROM THE VIEW OF ANANCIENTPERSON.
004-2. YOU'RE GOING FISHING TODAY?
004-3. YEAH, I FOUND A REALLY GOOD SPOT YESTERDAY.
004-4. WE CAN GIVE ONE TO MY PARENTS IF YOU CATCH A BIG ONE.
004-5. DURING THE NATIONAL DAYAND MID AUTUMN LONG HOLIDAY, JIANG HE CAN CARRY THE FISH THAT SHE CAUGHT, AND ENTER THE HOUSE WHILESHOUTING:
004-6. DAD!ICAUGHTA FISH FOR YOU TWO!
004-7. I'M LOOKING FORWARD TO THE OLD MAN'S REACTION.
004-8. SURE.
004-9. THAT REMINDS ME, I SAWSOME PEOPLE RELEASING SOME FISH INTO THE WATER THAT DAY TO ACCLIMULATE SOME GOOD KARMA. WHAT IF THOSE PEOPLE JUST HAND THE MONEY TO ME, AND I PROMISE NOT TO GO FISHING? WON'T THEY ACCUMULATE GOOD KARMA THAT WAY AS WELL?

Page 005
005-1. THEY ARE NOT DLMB,WHY WOULD THEY GIVE YOU MONEY?
005-2. DON'T THE MONKS IN THE TEMPLES DO THAT?
005-3. YOU HAND THEM MONEY, AND THEY WILL BESTOW GOOD KARMA UPONYOU.
005-4. IF THEY WERE TO HAND ME MONEY, I WOULD BE ABLE TO HELP THEM ACCLMU- LATE GOOD KARMA AS WELL.
005-5. YOU'LL HAVE TO SHAVE YOUR HEAD...
005-6. BALD...
005-7. WHAT ARE YOU DOING!?

Page 006
006-1. NO!! I ABSOLUTELY CANNOT SHAVE MY HEAD BALO!!
006-2. DARE TO BE ANGRY, BUT DON'T DARE TO SPEAK
006-3. YOU SEEM TO BE IN A GOOD MOOD DAY?
006-4. MHMM~
006-5. DID LITTLE JIANG HE LEARN THAT FROM PING- PING...AFTERALL, SHE WOULD FLASH THE FISH WHEN THEY'RE FISHING.
006-6. THANK THE HEAVENS FOR GRANTING ME THIS GIFT
006-7. I GOT YOU! MY DELICIOUS LITTLE KITTY!

Page 007
007-1. PERFECT TIMING, COME ANDACCOM- PANY ME.
007-2. OUR SAVINGS HAVEINCREASED, ANDOURSTOCKS HAVE RISEN A UTTLE, PLUS THE SAVINGS FROM UITTLE JIANG HE,
007-3. I CANCONSIDER TEACHING HER ABOUT REVERSE REPURCHASE AGREE- MENTS FOR TREASURY BONDS AND THE LIKE, OR ELSE SHE WILL LEARN ALL SORTS OF BAD THINGS FROMGONGPINGDURING HER FREE TIME...
007-4. While it seems like Xu Qing is lazing around all day, he actually breaks down his work into man- ageable parts,
007-5. Be it video editing. or when it comes to his savings, or even those film reviews that don't bring in much income.
007-6. It might seem easy, but in reality. he rarely gets a break,
007-7. It's just that he isn't shackled to a particular task all day.

Page 008
008-1. If he could,
008-2. He would want Jiang He to learn it all too.

Page 009
009-1. For ID-related matters in Jiangcheng, do I have to head to a main police station or just any police branch will do?
009-2. Why do I feel like you're up to no good with that sudden question?
009-3. Jiang He's ID hasn't been settled yet

Page 010
010-1. I nearly forgot, you're finally willing to get it done huh
010-2. Have you made a trip back to Zhecheng to check? You'd definitely have to do that at least
010-3. We'll talk about that when it's about to get started, I just wanted to check where I should go to avoid a wasted trip
010-4. Police branch, come to ours
010-5. Have you guys been busy lately?
010-6. wen儿哦wen儿哦
010-7. POLICE 出警
010-8. Why? If it's something I'm not supposed to do, save it
010-9. I have to pick a time when you guys are not as busy to get it done,it's not like we're We just need to take a photo We can just wait
010-10. It's nice of you to be thoughtful, but I'm not in the ID department
010-11. The people over there..
010-12. I'll help you keep an eye on them.
010-13. FORTHIS MATTER REGARDING LITTLE JIANG HE, BE IT HANDLED BY A SUPER-EFFICIENTLADY OR AN OLD AUNTIE,
010-14. IT BEATS IT GETTING HANDLED BY A METICULOUS AND METHODICALPERSON LIKE QIN HAO.

Page 011
011-1. AS A NORMAL CIVILIAN, ALL I CAN DO IS BE METICULOUS TO THE BEST OF MY ABILITIES,
011-2. IT MIGHT END UP BEING USELESS, BUT IT'S BETTERTHANJUST DIVING INTO IT HEADFIRST. THOUGH, I HOPE THAT EVERYTHING WILL BE GO WELL WITH ALL THE WORKIVE PUT IN.
011-3. QINGZI!
011-4. HAVE COME! TEA! SOME WHY ARE YOU ZONING OUT AT THE ENTRANCE!
011-5. SURE!
011-6. A YOUNG MAN LIKE YOU IS IDLING AROUND MORE THAN A PERSON LIKE ME?
011-7. THIS GUY WENT FOR A WALK WHILE HOLDING THAT FLASK OF HIS, WHILE HIS GIRL- FRIEND WENTOUTWITH HER FISHINGROD.ZOOMING BYON THEIR HOVERBOARDS WITH THEIR UTTLECONTRAPTIONS, MEAND MY FAMILYCAN'T AFFORD TO BE THAT IDLE.
011-8. I JUST LOOK LIKE I HAVE NOTHING TO DO.
011-9. IN REALITY? WHAT HAVE YOU BEEN DOING THAT LEAVES YOU SO TIRED?
011-10. IN REALITY, I HAVE EVEN LESS ON MY PLATE,AND I'M BORED OUT OF MY MIND.
011-11. THIS BRAT!
